blockers: Idle sheets are effectively duplicated across frames, so they do not provide readable animation at game scale.
The walk cycles show insufficient weight transfer and foot progression; many frames read as static pose swaps rather than locomotion.
Secondary motion is nearly absent: Celina's staff, Agnes's clothing, and Gambler's hat/robe do not react enough to body movement.
high_value_changes: Redesign the walk cycles around clear contact, passing, and recoil poses, with visible hip shift, torso counter-rotation, and alternating foot placement.
Add anticipation and settle to every signature gesture: compress before the action, exaggerate the peak, then hold and recover instead of interpolating through near-identical poses.
Introduce controlled idle variation: breathing, head tilt, garment sway, staff movement, and small hand offsets while keeping the feet and root anchored.
Strengthen the three identities with larger readable props and asymmetries at 192px; Celina's staff is currently too thin and Agnes's distinguishing details are weak.
Add minimal high-contrast facial or head-direction cues. The blank spherical faces currently read as mannequin-like and uncanny.
optional_notes: The lineup silhouettes separate well, especially Gambler's hat and raised arms, but Celina's robe collapses the lower-body read.
Hands are mostly small beige blobs at native scale; use clearer mitten wedges or stronger arm-to-hand silhouettes rather than relying on shading.
Gambler's gesture is the clearest signature motion. Agnes's card reveal is readable but visually dominates her body and needs a stronger setup pose.
The 2x nearest preview exposes soft 3D-render gradients and tiny detail rather than a deliberately authored pixel-scale hierarchy.
strongest_improvements: Strong cross-character silhouette separation in the lineup.
Distinct palette families for Celina, Agnes, and Gambler remain readable at native scale.
Signature gestures have clear semantic endpoints: staff extension, card presentation, and raised-arm spellcasting pose.
Root placement is generally stable across the displayed frame sets.
single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild all walk and idle timing around anchored contact points and materially different key poses; the current sheets look like repeated renders, not animation.
